name: Udio
desc: Music generation startup from former DeepMind researchers
desc_zh: 由前 DeepMind  researcher 创办的音乐生成平台，2024-04 公测
solves: Licensing a track for a video or a game takes weeks and costs more than the project. You generate the music and clear it.
solves_zh: 给一支视频或一款游戏配一首授权曲子，要谈上几周，花的钱比项目本身还多。你直接生成音乐，版权也归你。
best_for: When you need a music bed that fits the cut and does not come with a rights dispute.
best_for_zh: 当你需要一段配得上剪辑、且不会带来版权纠纷的背景音乐时。
